verdict.rationale: Otter AI Chat lets users ask natural-language questions across meetings and connected apps, query their CRM, and generate follow-ups, reports, and content. Through its MCP server, Claude or ChatGPT can search, recap, and draft follow-ups in chat. The documented natural-language surface covers querying and content generation, not operating the product itself (e.g., scheduling the notetaker, sharing, or managing settings by command). Missing for 10: natural-language control of product actions and configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the chat's command capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
